text: Let $a,b,c>1,a^{3},b^{3}$ and $c^{3}$ be in A.P., and $\log _{a}b,\log _{c}a$ and $\log _{b}c$ be in G.P. If the sum of first 20 terms of an A.P., whose first term is $\frac{a+4b+c}{3}$ and the common difference is $\frac{a-8b+c}{10}$ is $-444$, then $abc$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2023 (Online) 30th January Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Since $a^{3},b^{3},c^{3}$ are in A.P., $2b^{3}=a^{3}+c^{3}$.

Since $\log _{a}b,\log _{c}a,\log _{b}c$ are in G.P.,

$(\log _{c}a)^{2}=\log _{a}b\cdot \log _{b}c=\log _{a}c\Rightarrow \left (\dfrac{\ln a}{\ln c}\right )^{2}=\dfrac{\ln c}{\ln a}\Rightarrow (\ln a)^{3}=(\ln c)^{3}$

So $a=c$, and then $2b^{3}=2a^{3}$ gives $b=a$. Thus $a=b=c$.

First term $=\dfrac{a+4a+a}{3}=2a$ and common difference $=\dfrac{a-8a+a}{10}=-\dfrac{3a}{5}$.

$S_{20}=\dfrac{20}{2}\left [2(2a)+19\left (-\dfrac{3a}{5}\right )\right ]=10\cdot \dfrac{20a-57a}{5}=-74a$

$-74a=-444\Rightarrow a=6$, so $abc=6^{3}=216$.

Hence, the correct option is (B).
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2023 (Online) 30th January Evening Shift

text: The parabolas : $ax^{2}+2bx+cy=0$ and $dx^{2}+2ex+fy=0$ intersect on the line $y=1$. If $a,b,c,d,e,f$ are positive real numbers and $a,b,c$ are in G.P., then :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2023 (Online) 30th January Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Let point of intersection be ($α,1$)

$aα^{2}+2bα+c=0$ ..... (i)

and $dα^{2}+2eα+f=0$ .... (ii)

$\Rightarrow aα^{2}+2\sqrt{ac}α+c=0$ ($\because$ $b^{2}=ac$)

$\left (\sqrt{a}α+\sqrt{c}\right )^{2}=0$

$α=-\sqrt{\frac{c}{a}}$

Put the value of $α$ in (ii),

$d\frac{c}{a}-2e\sqrt{\frac{c}{a}}+f=0$

$\frac{d}{a}-\frac{2e}{\sqrt{ac}}+\frac{f}{c}=0$

$\frac{d}{a}+\frac{f}{c}=2\frac{e}{b}$

$\frac{d}{a},\frac{e}{b},\frac{f}{c}$ are in A.P.

text: Let $x=(8\sqrt{3}+13)^{13}$ and $y=(7\sqrt{2}+9)^{9}$. If $[t]$ denotes the greatest integer $\leq t$, then :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2023 (Online) 30th January Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
Since $8\sqrt{3}\approx 13.86$, the number $f=(8\sqrt{3}-13)^{13}$ satisfies $0<f<1$.

By the binomial theorem,

$x-f=(8\sqrt{3}+13)^{13}-(8\sqrt{3}-13)^{13}=2\sum\limits _{k\text{odd}}\left (13k\right )(8\sqrt{3})^{13-k}13^{k}.$

For odd $k$, $13-k$ is even, so $(8\sqrt{3})^{13-k}=192^{(13-k)/2}$ is an integer; hence $x-f=I_{1}$ is an even integer.

Then $x=I_{1}+f$ with $0<f<1$, so $[x]=I_{1}$ is even.

Similarly $7\sqrt{2}\approx 9.90$, so $g=(7\sqrt{2}-9)^{9}$ satisfies $0<g<1$, and

$y-g=2\sum\limits _{k\text{odd}}\left (9k\right )(7\sqrt{2})^{9-k}9^{k},$

where $(7\sqrt{2})^{9-k}=98^{(9-k)/2}$ is an integer; so $y-g=I_{2}$ is an even integer and $[y]=I_{2}$ is even.

Both $[x]$ and $[y]$ are even, so $[x]+[y]$ is even, while (A), (B) and (D) each need one of them to be odd.

Hence, the correct option is (C).
sourceReferences: ExamSIDE explanation for JEE Main 2023 (Online) 30th January Evening Shift

text: Let $P(a_{1},b_{1})$ and $Q(a_{2},b_{2})$ be two distinct points on a circle with center $C(\sqrt{2},\sqrt{3})$. Let $\mathrm{O}$ be the origin and $\mathrm{OC}$ be perpendicular to both $\mathrm{CP}$ and $\mathrm{CQ}$. If the area of the triangle $\mathrm{OCP}$ is $\frac{\sqrt{35}}{2}$, then $a_{1}^{2}+a_{2}^{2}+b_{1}^{2}+b_{2}^{2}$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2023 (Online) 30th January Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$OC⊥CP$ and $OC⊥CQ$

$\Rightarrow PCQ$ is a straight line


[IMG]


$OC=\sqrt{(\sqrt{2})^{2}+(\sqrt{3})^{2}}=\sqrt{5}$

Let $CP=CQ=I$

$[OCP]=\frac{1}{2}\times OC\times I=\frac{\sqrt{35}}{2}$

$I=\sqrt{7}$

$OP=OQ=\sqrt{(OC)^{2}+I^{2}}=\sqrt{5+7}=\sqrt{12}$

$a_{1}^{2}+a_{2}^{2}+b_{1}^{2}+b_{2}^{2}=\left (a_{1}^{2}+b_{1}^{2}\right )+\left (a_{2}^{2}+b_{2}^{2}\right )$

$OP^{2}+OQ^{2}=12+12=24$

text: Let a line $L$ pass through the point $P(2,3,1)$ and be parallel to the line $x+3y-2z-2=0=x-y+2z$. If the distance of $L$ from the point $(5,3,8)$ is $α$, then $3α^{2}$ is equal to :
sourceReference: NTA JEE Main JEE Main 2023 (Online) 30th January Evening Shift via ExamSIDE (questions.examside.com)

solution.body:
$L:\frac{x-2}{1}=\frac{y-3}{-1}=\frac{z-1}{-1}=λ$

Any point on L can be taken as

$B(λ+2,-λ+3,-λ+1)$

Let $A(5,3,8)$

So, $AB.\qquad (\hat{i}-\hat{j}-\widehat{k})=0$

$[(λ-3)\hat{i}-λ\hat{j}-(λ+7)\widehat{k}].[\hat{i}-\hat{j}-\widehat{k}]=0$

$λ-3+λ+λ+7=0$

$\therefore$ $λ=\frac{-4}{3}$

$AB\leftarrow =-\frac{13}{3}\hat{i}+\frac{4}{3}\hat{j}-\frac{17}{3}\widehat{k}$

$|AB\leftarrow |=\sqrt{\frac{169}{9}+\frac{16}{9}+\frac{289}{9}}$

$=\frac{\sqrt{474}}{3}=α$

$3α^{2}=\frac{474}{9}\times 3=158$
